labels.expectedValue: Yes, in three circumstances: (1) Casualty — if Landlord determines the Building can't reasonably be repaired within 180 days of damage/destruction, either party may terminate (Section 11.03); Landlord may also terminate for an uninsured casualty (Section 11.04). (2) Condemnation — the Lease terminates automatically on a full taking (Section 12.01); either party has rights on a partial taking that renders the Premises unusable (Section 12.02). (3) Landlord's Right to Cancel — in connection with any proposed assignment or full-Premises sublease, Landlord may instead elect to cancel and terminate the Lease (or the relevant portion, for a partial sublease) by notice within 30 days of Tenant's request (Section 14.02).
